_purpose: The ONLY catalog the showrunner reads. Every id here is valid in episode_shotlist.json.

Set_BrickCreatorDesk.notes: creator room: standing desk, monitor with code, 3 mugs, bookshelf, window, poster, rug

Set_BrickCafeStreet.notes: street + sidewalk, cafe facade with glowing window, striped awning, tables, lamp, tree

Set_BrickOfficeStage.notes: keynote stage, giant chart screen, podium, spot cans

Set_CityStreetCorner.notes: corner street: cafe facade with awning + bookshop, sidewalk tables, crosswalk, traffic light, parked car, bench; side streets and skyline all around
Set_CityStreetCorner.best_for: walks, chance encounters, crowd gags, high-angle traffic establish

Set_ApartmentCutaway.notes: cutaway apartment: living room (sofa, TV, rug, floor lamp, window to the city) + bedroom (bed, night lamp); ceiling and walls hide for top shots
Set_ApartmentCutaway.best_for: everyday relatable stories, late-night spirals, morning routines, overhead isolation shots

Set_OfficeFloor.notes: open office: 2 desk clusters with monitors, glass meeting room with long table and a whiteboard chart, water cooler, big windows to towers
Set_OfficeFloor.best_for: workplace satire, deadpan corporate humor, whiteboard/chart beats

Set_MiniMart.notes: convenience store: 3 shelf aisles of colourful generic boxes, red checkout counter, glowing fridges, glass shopfront with generic MART / 24H / OPEN neon
Set_MiniMart.best_for: night-shift stories, quirky customers, suspense and satire

Set_ParkPlaza.notes: park plaza on an overlook: fountain, cross paths, benches, trees, flower bed, railing over a lower city and a sunset skyline
Set_ParkPlaza.best_for: wide reflective moments, bird's-eye scale, golden-hour dialogue

Set_BusStop.notes: bus stop: glass shelter with bench and map panel, route-7 sign pole, generic white/teal bus at the curb, street and shops behind
Set_BusStop.best_for: commuter comedy, internal monologue, waiting gags

Set_InstructionVoid.notes: clean instruction-manual studio sweep: pedestal where a small house assembles step by step, 3-step brick bar chart, giant pale bricks far away
Set_InstructionVoid.best_for: visual metaphors, comparisons, fast explanatory cutaways (assembly)

mouths_auto: lip-sync is automatic from audio; non-speaking frames use the expression's rest mouth

actions.point_explain: one-shot, right arm points to figure's right (screen-left when facing camera)

camera_presets.assembly_high: high wide for the brick-assembly opener
camera_presets.mcu: medium close-up of subjects[0], honours subject_zone via lens shift
camera_presets.ews: extreme wide / establishing: whole set + midground + skyline (no subject needed)
camera_presets.ws: wide: characters inside the environment (subjects optional)
camera_presets.mls: medium long: full body language + props (1 subject)
camera_presets.ots: over-the-shoulder: subjects[0] is filmed, subjects[1] is the blurred shoulder in front

arrow.note: normalised screen coords, must not end on a face

ui_zone_rule: A shot with a card/chart sets subject_zone to the OPPOSITE third of its ui_safe_zone. Subtitles own the bottom band (y>0.83).

camera_angles.low_angle: looks up: heroic or satirical ego boost
camera_angles.birds_eye: top-down pattern / maze / crowd; ceilings and walls hide automatically

visual_intents.cutaway_gag: quick cut to another set or the instruction stage
